headline.purpose: The page title. One per route.

title.purpose: A record name on a card. 19px on a full card.

body.purpose: The page default, inherited by every control. Prose caps at 70ch.

body-small.purpose: Record descriptions and secondary prose. Notes cap at 62ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase field captions and section headings, in Ash Violet Low.

badge.purpose: Every tag: kind, tier, source, unique, Hope and Fear.

numeral.purpose: Monospace for any number a person compares: roll numbers, stat lines, step rungs, the number field at 20px.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: The only elevation token. Panels and cards, at rest.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The toast alone, which is not a plate but a top-layer element.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: The A4 print sheet on screen. Removed under print media.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: The gold glow on a focused input well. Takes the die's own colour on the duality fields.

shadows.name: pressed-inset
shadows.purpose: The one pushed-in state in the system: a primary button while its menu is open.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Every control state change: border, colour, background. No transform.

motion.name: card-in
motion.purpose: A record card entering: 10px up and 0.985 to 1.

motion.name: image-zoom
motion.purpose: A compact card image scaling to 1.05 on hover. The only scale in the system, and only under (hover: hover).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reduced motion uses a zero duration rather than removing transitions, so the print card's synchronous fitting read-back still sees the end state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a panel. One per panel.
components.css: .ds-btn { border: 1px solid var(--line2, #3f3758); background: var(--surface, #1a1626); color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); padding: 0 18px; height: 46px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 9px); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e2b76c, var(--gold, #d8ab5e)); border-color: #e8c27c; color: var(--ink-on-gold, #1a1206); font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #c99b52, #b8873f); border-color: #c99b52; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #d8ab5e); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 9px); }

components.name: Plain Button
components.description: The default button. Hover moves the border to gold and never lifts the control.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { border: 1px solid var(--line2, #3f3758); background: var(--surface, #1a1626); color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); padding: 0 18px; height: 46px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 9px); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; } .ds-btn2 svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: currentcolor; flex: none; } .ds-btn2:hover { border-color: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); background: var(--surface2, #221d31); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #d8ab5e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip Row
components.description: One choice in a row of them. Muted outline at rest, gold fill when chosen.
components.css: .ds-chiprow { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--line2, #3f3758); background: var(--surface, #1a1626); color: var(--muted, #9b93b3); padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 540; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; } .ds-chip small { display: block; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); } .ds-chip-on { background: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); border-color: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); color: var(--ink-on-gold, #1a1206); font-weight: 650; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #d8ab5e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: The language switch and the list/grid view switch. A pill track holding pill buttons.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; background: var(--surface, #1a1626); border: 1px solid var(--line, #312a45); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; font-family: var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9b93b3); padding: 5px 13px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.16s; } .ds-seg button:not(.ds-seg-on):hover { color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); } .ds-seg-on { background: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); color: var(--ink-on-gold, #1a1206); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #d8ab5e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: A well cut into the plate: darker than the surface it sits in, gold on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; height: 46px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 9px); background: var(--bg2, #14111d); border: 1px solid var(--line2, #3f3758); color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); font: 15.5px/1.6 var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted2, #8a83a3); opacity: 0.7; } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(216 171 94 / 14%); }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: The roll input: a monospace value between two steppers. The whole row takes the focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-num { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--bg2, #14111d); border: 1px solid var(--line2, #3f3758); border-radius: var(--r-sm, 9px); overflow: hidden; } .ds-num input { width: 74px; height: 46px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); text-align: center; font: 650 20px/1 var(--mono, ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace); } .ds-num input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-num:focus-within { border-color: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(216 171 94 / 14%); } .ds-num button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9b93b3); width: 40px; height: 46px; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.14s; } .ds-num button:hover { background: var(--surface2, #221d31); color: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The plate every roll mode and every list sits on: a top-down gradient inside one seam, with the only shadow in the system.

Результат броска
Панель держит одно поле или несколько; последнее поле теряет нижний отступ.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface2, #221d31), var(--surface, #1a1626)); border: 1px solid var(--line, #312a45); border-radius: var(--r, 14px); padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 10px 34px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 85%); font-family: var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); } .ds-lbl { display: block; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted2, #8a83a3); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-panel-body { font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #312a45); } .ds-tab { flex: none; text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted, #9b93b3); padding: 9px 13px 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 560; white-space: nowrap; transition: 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--txt, #ece8f6); } .ds-tab-on { color: var(--gold-soft, #f0d091); border-bottom-color: var(--gold, #d8ab5e); } .ds-tab-sep { margin-left: auto; }

components.css: .ds-pcard { box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; overflow: hidden; container-type: size; width: 238px; height: 333px; border: 0.4mm dashed #c9c4d2; background: #fff; color: #000; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; font-family: var(--ui, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-pc-art { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 100cqw; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #0a0810; } .ds-pc-glyph { width: 34cqw; height: 36cqw; fill: #e6e3ec; } .ds-pc-body { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 4cqw 6cqw 5cqw; } .ds-pc-name { display: block; font-size: 7cqw; font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-pc-desc { margin: 2cqw 0 0; font-size: 4.2cqw; line-height: 1.35; }

narrative.overview:
The product is a treasury seen through its index. The ground is a deep violet ink, almost black, lit by two wide radial washes that never resolve into an object. On that ground sit the index cards: panels, record cards and table rows, each one a slightly lighter violet plate inside a single hairline seam. Every artefact carries a coloured tag that says what kind of thing it is, and a numbered seal in monospace that says where it stands in its book. Gold is the seal wax. It appears on the thing a person has chosen, and almost nowhere else.

The mood is quiet, exact and solemn. Nothing here is staged: the type scale is small and even, the contrast values were measured rather than guessed, and the one accent is rationed. The catalogue holds 1091 records in two languages, so density is a requirement, not a preference. The design earns its ceremony from the numbering and the tagging, which are real information, and never from ornament.

There are no webfonts. The font stacks are lists of locally installed families, so the first paint is the final paint. This is a load-bearing property of the world, not an omission: the app also runs from file://, and the print sheet must measure identically on a machine that has never been online.
keyCharacteristics: One accent colour, spent only on the chosen thing.
A five-hue tag system that lives on badges alone.
Tonal depth from a four-step surface ramp, plus exactly one shadow.
A locked type scale of sixteen sizes, enforced by a test.
Monospace for every number a person compares.
Two worlds in one product: the dark screen, and the white printed card.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Seal Gold marks what the person chose: a chip they picked, the tab they are on, the control they focused, the main action of the panel they are in. Gold on something nobody selected is wrong.

rules.name: The Tag Rule
rules.body: The five kind hues live on the badge and nowhere else. A stat line stays secondary text. A row does not take a kind colour, and neither does a card border. The tag is the only place a category becomes a colour.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on a gold fill is Ink on Gold (#1a1206), never a page surface colour and never white.

rules.name: The Sixteen Steps Rule
rules.body: The scale is exactly 23, 20, 19, 18, 17, 16, 15.5, 14, 13.5, 13, 12.5, 12, 11.5, 11, 10.5 and 9.5 px. tests/app/typo.js measures every rendered element on thirteen routes against that list and fails on a size that is not in it. A new step is a decision, and it lands in both places or not at all.

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: A number a person compares is monospace: a roll number, a stat line, a rung in an upgrade chain, the value in a number field. A number a person reads as prose is not.

rules.name: The Local Font Rule
rules.body: No @font-face and no font service, ever. The families are lists of locally installed names. Anything else breaks the file:// case and moves the print measurements.

rules.name: The One Width Rule
rules.body: Anything that spans the page takes var(--wrap). A new full-width element does not invent its own container or its own gutter.

rules.name: The Two Breakpoints Rule
rules.body: The system has two. At 640px the tab strip stops wrapping and becomes a horizontal scroller that keeps the current tab centred. At 600px touch targets grow. Every other media query in the code belongs to one component and its own measured problem. Do not add a third system breakpoint.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: New work uses the Plate shadow or no shadow. A second elevation step is a change to the system, not a component decision.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: A pill means one of these, choosable. A rounded rectangle means a thing. Do not round a card to a pill or square a chip.

dos: Do spend Seal Gold only on the chosen thing: a picked chip, the current tab, a focused control, the main action of a panel.
Do take a new text size from the sixteen-step scale, and add the step to tests/app/typo.js in the same change when a new one is truly needed.
Do build depth from the four surface steps and the one-pixel seam, and reach for the Plate shadow when a plate has to lift.
Do set every number a person compares in the monospace face.
Do keep the five kind hues on badges alone.
Do span the page with var(--wrap) and nothing else.
Do let the global :focus-visible ring reach the control. Override outline-offset alone, and only where clipping proves it necessary.
Do grow touch targets at 600px rather than shipping a pointer-sized target to a phone.
donts: Don't drift toward a neon dark mode: no saturated purple or cyan glow, no gradient text, no coloured drop shadow. The ground is violet, which makes this a short slide, and the palette's restraint is what keeps 1091 records legible.

Don't drift toward a SaaS dashboard: no generic blue accent, no oversized rounded cards, no illustrated empty states, no marketing gradient. The density these tables need is the opposite of that language.
Don't add a second shadow step, a third system breakpoint, or a sixth radius.
Don't move a control on hover. Hover changes colour and border, never position or scale.
Don't declare an @font-face or link a font service.
Don't put a kind colour on a row, a card border, or body text.
Don't set white text on a gold fill. Ink on Gold is the only text colour there.
